name: ABYSS
source:
The year is 3001. Mankind has conquered the galaxy and established an alliance to protect peace in the known space. The galactic federation of the ninth planet sends a man into deep space on a confidential operation known as "Abyss". However, the commander is captured by a criminal syndicate. His memory is erased, and he is rendered unable to communicate with his allies. His goal is to escape and find a way to return to the mother ship.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/abyss__]mobygames[/url]]
translation:
时间是3001年。人类已经征服银河，并建立联盟维护已知宇宙的和平。第九行星的银河联邦派出一名男子深入太空，执行代号“深渊”的机密任务。然而，指挥官遭犯罪集团俘虏，记忆被抹除，也无法再与盟友联络。他必须设法逃脱，并找到返回母舰的方法。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/abyss__]mobygames[/url]]
